mapper.select: SELECT s.*, COUNT(p.id) AS post_count FROM series s LEFT JOIN post p ON p.series_id = s.id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.sort ASC, s.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO series (name, description, sort) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET series_id = NULL WHERE series_id = #{seriesId}
